title: Apps Like Picrew: 8 Picrew Alternatives for Making Your Own Character (2026)
summary: Looking for apps like Picrew? Compare Picrew alternatives for designing your own original character, from portrait makers to 3D avatars. Verified store prices.
body_markdown:
Picrew is the go-to for quick character portraits. Its App Store listing describes 10,000+ image makers from creators worldwide. But each maker is a fixed set of parts, so sometimes you want more control, a full body, or a character who does something.


Here are the best apps like Picrew for building your own original character, grouped by what they add.


*Redbean is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the apps or companies named here. App names are trademarks of their owners. No official artwork is used on this page.*


Store details checked on the US App Store and Google Play on October 24, 2026. Prices and labels can change, so check the listing before you download.


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


First: Picrew has an official app


#


Picrew.me links to **Picrew PFP & OC Maker** by TETRACHROMA INC. **Developer:** TETRACHROMA INC.. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases; App Store age rating 17+. If you only want Picrew on your phone, start there.


##


The best Picrew alternatives


#


###


1. Dollify: closest to Picrew’s feel


#


A portrait avatar maker. The listing describes picking items from 14 categories with color variations. **Developer:** Dave XP. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists in-app purchases.
**Pick it if:** you want one consistent style and a quick profile picture.


###


2. Gacha Life 2: full body plus scenes


#


Design a character with thousands of outfits and hairstyles, then use the Studio to stage scenes and stories. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads.
**Pick it if:** you want to go from a portrait to a whole cast.


###


3. Gacha Club: characters, pets and backgrounds


#


Similar to Gacha Life 2. The listing states customization is free with no in-app purchases. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads; the listing says customization has no in-app purchases.


###


4. VRoid Mobile: Picrew, but 3D


#


An avatar camera app: combine face, hair and body parts, adjust them with sliders, change clothes and take photos. **Developer:** pixiv. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists in-app purchases.
**Pick it if:** you want to rotate and pose your character.


###


5. Bitmoji: a cartoon version of you


#


An expressive cartoon avatar with a sticker library. **Developer:** Bitstrips / Bitmoji. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play.
**Pick it if:** the “character” is you, for chats.


###


6. Everskies: avatar plus wardrobe


#


An avatar maker and dress-up life sim with a community. **Developer:** PocketzWorld / Pocket Worlds. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


###


7. ZEPETO: avatar plus social worlds


#


A 3D avatar you take into thousands of virtual worlds. **Developer:** NAVER Z. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


###


8. Redbean: when the portrait isn’t enough


#


Redbean is free to download. Its App Store listing describes a town where your original characters live, build relationships and create stories, which picks up where a portrait leaves off.


##


Picrew vs alternatives at a glance


#


Want Try

Full body plus scenes Gacha Life 2, Gacha Club

##


Tips for designing an original character in any portrait maker


#


- Pick **one standout feature** (a color, a scar, an accessory) and keep it in every version.
- Save a **palette** : 3–4 colors you reuse.
- Write **three personality words** before you start, and pick parts that match them.
- Check each maker’s **usage rules** before posting or reusing art.


For the full process, see[how to make your own character from scratch](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/make-your-own-character/) .


##


FAQ


#


**Is there a Picrew app?** Yes. Picrew.me links to Picrew PFP & OC Maker on the App Store and Google Play.


**What’s the best free app like Picrew?** Dollify for the closest feel, and Gacha Club if you want full bodies and scenes. Both are free to download.


**Is there a 3D Picrew?** VRoid Mobile builds 3D avatars with sliders.
